note: Every trader the campaign stands in a town. A trader is an entity, and a re-export regenerates every region and entity file from the WorldPainter project, so a trader summoned in game is erased by every export. This manifest is the source: tools/traders.py function writes the re-application function, and the post-export procedure in docs/world-building/REEXPORT.md (R14) runs it. Nothing is summoned by hand. tools/validate_data.py checks the static rules, and exactly-one presence in a stopped world passed with --world-save.

fields.id: stable id; the entity carries the tags cobblers_vendor and cobblers_vendor_<id>
fields.settlement: the town in data/placements.json whose plaza the trader stands on
fields.template: the installed shopkeeper template the trader's entity is read from (its trade list, name and look)
fields.source: where that template ships, and its licence: placed by resource id, never copied into the repo
fields.position: {x, y, z}: the block the trader stands in, one above the plaza paving the town plan grades
fields.status: planned (not in the campaign world), placed (re-applied by the function), verified (checked in game)
fields.chosen_because: why this trader, in this town
